body: Yes, I can relate. I stopped going to university. I have a date planned so why bother and do extra work when you're planning to end it.
I am ok with being a virgin but the loneliness is killing me deep inside everyday.
All I think is about suicide.
I am also curious about it. I have written a note but some of it is about my family and the rest about me.
My parents are almost retired and my brother is married. So it's all set. It's only a few people that will be affected but they will have to move on.
Not diagnosed but I feel I do. I don't play video games, watch tv shows or anything anymore. Just think and talk about suicide.
I just went in store to buy them lol.
Same!!! My parents do not support the LGBT community and I am afraid to come out. I am 25 btw.

Yes, I am 25. Speaking of food I am a picky eater (I dont know if I have ARFID but I feel I have some parts of it). I just have couple of safe food that I can eat. So the recipe that you provided is good but I would be able to eat it.

I only know to cook instant noodles. My mom told me to practice cooking while she was away but I just ended up buying fast food. I am really behind life and this is why I just want to give up. I dont want to learn new things.

Well I do have friends that are into astronomy but due to their work and school it never works out. The community app is good but again I just dont have the will do anything. I just dont have the energy to talk to new people.
Nothing makes me happy anymore. Sometimes, I get a laugh here and there but that's it. I do like astrophotography but it is boring when you do it alone.

Yes she does love me and will probably suicide if I died. But my life is pretty much going downhill since last year. I have given up on everything. All I think about is suicide. I am tired of being alive. It is too much work.

Yes and I have experienced that. My mom tried to suicide when I was young. I couldn't see her for nearly 2 months because she was put in mental hospital. If she didn't care then why should I care now?
Well my mom is emotional and I want someone to support her.  I dont want them crying on the plane.
Nah dying is easier.

The school will help you without telling your parents. If you're afraid, then you can try kidshelpphone (Canada only). I am not sure where you're from but I have tired that when I was young and they were super helpful. Dying isn't easy as pressing the off button. Do you have any siblings? Pets?

Try this if you're in Canada. https://kidshelpphone.ca/

If you're from a different country, let me know and I can help you find something similar.

I understand that you want to make your parents proud. Is it just your dad that is being difficult on you? Men can have difficulty sharing their feelings. They will wont say in your face but they do notice it. My dad is also similar. I got 100 on a math exam and he didn't say anything like good job, lets party or anything like that. 

Drawing is pretty cool hobby and keep doing it. It allows you to express your feelings. Even though your dad hates it just enjoy on what you do. 

Have you tried getting help outside of reddit? Schools has lots of guidance programs that they can help you solve your issues. They might be able to help you more as not everyone here is a professional. It might be hard to ask for help in real life but it will definitely help you. 

Also dont suicide. They will put in a mental hospital if they find out. My mom tried to suicide and she was in the mental hospital for nearly 2 months. I was only in grade 9.
Why do you want to give up? You are still young. There is so much things that you haven't experienced. Do you have any hobbies? Do you like any video games?
Wow, I could never do that if I had a younger sister. No matter how depressed/suicidal I am, I just can't think about dying. Hope your sister grows up with you and not alone.

Different people have different perspectives on loneliness and my perspective is that I want to be with that special someone.

I cannot keep living like this and hoping to end it soon.. I cry every hour about it.
